connector.name: Codex MCP Bridge
connector.registryDescription: Wraps Codex CLI as MCP tools: codex, review, query, search, structured, ping, listSessions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package codex-mcp-bridge. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hampsterx account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: CODEX_CLI_PATH
env.description: Path to the codex CLI binary. Defaults to 'codex' on PATH.

env.name: CODEX_FALLBACK_MODEL
env.description: Model to use when the primary model hits a quota error.

env.name: CODEX_MCP_SERVERS
env.description: Controls which MCP servers from ~/.codex/config.toml stay enabled inside the Codex subprocess. Empty/unset disables all non-required servers; 'inherit' passes config through; comma-separated names (e.g. 'serena,github') enables those; values starting with '{' or '[' are raw TOML.
